selectionRule: Select actual included tasks, then transitive implementation dependencies and affected shared-file/schema/protocol tasks. Evaluate acceptanceDependencies, scoped conditions, contracts and environment gates at validation/release; do not require all 20 packages. Templates are not sufficient approval.
candidateRequiredFields: safe rollback artifact/schema/data compatibility OR approved containment
full restore-point pair and cleanup plan
firstSafeReleaseRule: If an older version reopens a confirmed defect or cannot read the current schema/protocol, it is not a safe fallback. Require approved maintenance/write stop/feature isolation with preserved recovery point instead; no imaginary rollback target.
findingClosureRule: SUPPORTED is evidence of a defect. Mark FIX_ACCEPTED only for the actual fixed baseline and passed applicable original assertion inverse, durable state, shared contracts and target evidence. RISK_ACCEPTED is separate and not FIXED.
programmeClosureRule: Reconcile all 32 confirmed records, not only P1; each FIX_ACCEPTED or explicitly scoped risk disposition with remaining risk. R12-N01 must have evidence-supported candidate disposition. All included changes satisfy local/target/release gates; audit completion is separate.
